summary: New L'Equipaggio (crew) feature verified end-to-end. Backend: all 33 pytest tests pass (7 new for crew list/detail/404/application full/minimal/validation/no-public-list + 26 regression). Frontend: /equipaggio renders header + Luigi full-poster card (crew-card-crew_luigi_volpe) + join-crew-button; tap navigates to /equipaggio/crew_luigi_volpe showing Ministero/Programmi/Testimonianza and crew-profile-back; /join validates required fields, submits with backend and shows join-done success; Home collaborators-section shows crew teaser with Luigi Volpe; About page removed old collaborator names and shows about-crew-cta linking to /equipaggio; Profilo menu-/equipaggio present and navigates correctly. Deprecation console warnings only (shadow* / pointerEvents) - non-blocking.

react_native_issues.issue: Non-blocking console warnings: 'shadow* style props are deprecated (use boxShadow)' and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated (use style.pointerEvents)' - carried over from iteration 1.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py: no admin/authenticated GET endpoint exists to review submitted /api/crew/applications - by design per spec (not exposed via public GET). Ensure an admin/CMS path exists before launch to actually read applications.
join.tsx uses expo-image-picker - correctly OPTIONAL; on web the picker won't open but submit works without portrait (verified).
get_crew returns 'portrait_key' and 'portrait' (null) - frontend crewAssets.crewPortrait must map portrait_key='luigi' to local asset; verify mapping exists (not inspected).

success_rate.frontend: 100% - crew list, profile navigation, join form validation + submission, home teaser, about CTA, profilo menu entry all verified

seed_data_creation: Startup seed inserts Luigi Volpe crew doc (id=crew_luigi_volpe, poster=true, published=true) on first boot. Tests created transient TEST_ crew_applications docs (2) + prior TEST_ prayer/message/contact docs; no cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env. Crew endpoints: GET /api/crew, GET /api/crew/{id} (404 for unknown), POST /api/crew/applications ({ok:true}, 422 if missing motivation/name/surname/email/desired_role). Applications are write-only (no public GET). Frontend testIDs: crew-card-crew_luigi_volpe, crew-profile-back, join-crew-button, join-back, join-name/surname/age/city/email/phone/testimony/motivation/experience, join-role-<Role> (Speaker|Conduttore|Tecnico del suono|Redazione|Social & Comunicazione|Preghiera|Altro), join-portrait, join-submit, join-done, about-crew-cta, collaborators-section, menu-/equipaggio. Portrait upload OPTIONAL - form submits fine without it on web.
